narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in northeastern Maryland on the morning of September 23. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to 5 inches.
ev: A vehicle was stranded in flood waters at the intersection of Main Street and Melvin Avenue in Queenstown, leading to a water rescue.
Maryland Route 298 was closed near Fairlee due to flooding.
lsr: WATER RESCUE WITH A VEHICLE STRANDED AT THE INTERSECTION OF MELVIN AVE AND MAIN ST.
STATE HIGHWAY 298 CLOSED FROM FLASH FLOODING. TIME BASED ON DISPATCH REPORT.
